author: Milki
body:
Junior Mod/Moderator Targeting Association

Credit to lunax564 for inspiration on targeting Junior Moderators.

This is a team I've decided to make for fun, where the central focus is to target and kill all of those (not nise) Junior Mods and Moderators. #TargetTheModerators

There is no minimal commitment, no scrims, nothing. All you need to do to get onto this team is to make a post to say that you would like to join.

If you are already on another team, you can join this one, since we don't compete.

Please add my Skype at milkcreamyum and leave your MC username so I know who it is, thanks :D

I'll update the roster when I can.

Roster (Just in case the Mods want to see who to wary of :P)
-MilkCream
-Splade4812
